modalities.evidence: eye-tracking data collected while radiologists dictated reports

output.population: Five radiologists reading 3,032 frontal chest x-ray cases from MIMIC-CXR; a subset of 109 chest x-rays was read by all radiologists.
output.summary: Eye-tracking recordings and time-synchronized dictation transcripts from five radiologists reading 3,032 frontal chest x-ray cases from MIMIC-CXR, with image-level abnormality labels, ellipses localizing anomalies, and bounding boxes around lungs and heart.
